title: Spacemine's and Felinor Containment Chamber's Deaths read the stats they died with
notes: Spacemine's Death hit and Felinor Containment Chamber's Death token read the Attack (and max Health) of the card's own destroyed event, auras included (R4396000); the scripts of v0.6.9e are kept (script_v0_6_9e). Overdrive Module has no script change: classify's stage 2 found its forced games play differently, so its claim is here.

player.title: Deaths read the stats the card died with
fixes: Spacemine's Death hit for its Attack with auras left off, so under Warp Disruptor a card showing 7 dealt 5. It now deals the Attack it showed as it died, a lowering aura included.
Felinor Containment Chamber's Death summoned a token of its stats with auras left off, so a 4/1 under Warp Disruptor made a 2/1. The token now has the Attack and Health the Chamber showed as it died.
